facts.fact: Connected TV lets a tutoring or test prep center run a 30-second spot on premium streaming channels targeted to families in its area, per the vendor.
facts.quote: Connected TV lets you run a 30-second spot on premium streaming channels, targeted to families in your area

facts.fact: According to the vendor, AI tools can generate a broadcast-quality 30-second ad from a center's website in minutes.
facts.quote: AI tools can generate a broadcast-quality 30-second ad from your website in minutes

facts.fact: The vendor recommends launching video and social awareness ads in early-to-mid August for back-to-school tutoring advertising.
The vendor recommends adding or increasing search advertising from late August through September as the peak capture window for back-to-school tutoring advertising.
The vendor recommends keeping a lighter advertising presence from October onward to catch a second wave, including test-prep families targeting fall and winter exam dates.
The page was published on July 19, 2026.
Adwave's pricing page says users can get started with its advertising service from $30 a day.
facts.quote: check [pricing](https://adwave.com/pricing) to get started from $30 a day before the back-to-school rush.

facts.fact: Adwave says it can generate a 30-second video ad from a business's website.
facts.quote: generate a 30-second video ad from your website, then run it across connected TV, YouTube, Google, Meta, and more from one place.

facts.fact: Adwave advises tutoring and test prep centers to start back-to-school awareness advertising in early-to-mid August, before demand peaks.
facts.quote: Start your awareness advertising in early-to-mid August, before demand peaks.
